mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rising > 0.5% does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rising > 1% does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increase does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supportive monetary policy and strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS decrease and INDPRO increase does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test.
